hooks.text: 二十种舰船拥有主动与被动能力，并能搭配自选武器；每艘船和每件武器还各有独立技能树。
hooks.excerpt: Choose from a wide variety of ships each with their own unique active and passive abilities, ranging from shocking tesla towers and a burning laser, to clones that mirror your attacks or the ability to slow time around you. Pick the ship the suits your play style and outfit it with a weapon of your choice. Every ship and weapon has it's own unique skill tree, allowing you to alter and improve the way they play via changing abilities/passives and gaining new ones.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 击杀经验可换取无限叠加升级，既能堆叠状态效果，也能召唤携带武器的构造体军团。
hooks.excerpt: Gain experience by killing enemies to improve your ship with infinitely stacking upgrades that allow you to tailor your build as you play. Inflict a barrage of status effects on your enemies, or summon a swarm of constructs with their own weaponry.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 细粒度难度修改器可让墙壁带电或给敌人附加元素，高难度还会解锁强化Boss变体与额外奖励。
hooks.excerpt: Customize your own difficulty with many modifiers from electrifying the walls, to giving enemies elemental infusions. Higher difficulties can unlock prime boss variants for an even greater challenge and further rewards.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
